note: Litt acknowledges worries of a gloomy future in which institutions designed around proving theorems stall human understanding, and the need for a radical rethinking of the profession if such a future is to be avoided. He remains relatively enthusiastic for using AI in mathematics. He proposes awarding the PhD mainly on a rigorous defence in which students explain their topic to examiners, interviewing graduate applicants, a stronger seminar culture and rewarding research programmes and community-building. The essay also appears on Proofs and Prompts.
title: A beginning for mathematics
